description: This file is a shell script containing a test suite for handling git remote groups, including setup, updates, and error conditions.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Writes a given string to the file 'mark'.

methods.name: update_repo
methods.description: Updates a local repository by creating a new commit with content and a commit message from 'mark'.

methods.name: update_repos
methods.description: Updates multiple repositories by calling 'update_repo' for each.

methods.name: repo_fetched
methods.description: Checks if a repository has been fetched by comparing the latest commit message to 'mark'.
